phy-graphql-schema-audit 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Scans GraphQL SDL files or introspection JSON to detect N+1 query risks, unbounded query depth, circular type references, deprecated field usage, naming convention issues, missing pagination on collections, and overly broad scalar usage.
- Outputs a prioritized, actionable issue list with resolver-level fix hints and complexity budget recommendations.
- No external API calls — all analysis is local and works with any schema format.
- Supports multiple input methods and offers flexible CLI options for focusing on specific audit categories.
